parameters.command:
={{
`SUBTITLE_FILE="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.subtitle}"

if [ -s "$SUBTITLE_FILE" ]; then
  echo "SUCCESS: subtitle exists"
  echo "FILE: $SUBTITLE_FILE"
  ls -lh "$SUBTITLE_FILE"
else
  echo "ERROR: subtitle not found or empty"
  echo "EXPECTED: $SUBTITLE_FILE"
  exit 1
fi`
}}

={{
`FINAL_FILE="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.final_video}"

if [ -s "$FINAL_FILE" ]; then
  echo "SUCCESS: Final Shorts exists"
  echo "FILE: $FINAL_FILE"
  ls -lh "$FINAL_FILE"
else
  echo "ERROR: Final Shorts not found or empty"
  echo "EXPECTED: $FINAL_FILE"
  exit 1
fi`
}}

={{
`
RUN_FOLDER="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.run_folder}"
ANCHOR_FOLDER="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.anchor_folder}"
SCENE_VIDEO_FOLDER="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.scene_video_folder}"
TTS_FOLDER="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.tts_folder}"
SUBTITLE_FOLDER="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.subtitle_folder}"
FINAL_FOLDER="${$('Pipeline Config').first().json.paths.final_folder}"

mkdir -p "$RUN_FOLDER" "$ANCHOR_FOLDER" "$SCENE_VIDEO_FOLDER" "$TTS_FOLDER" "$SUBTITLE_FOLDER" "$FINAL_FOLDER" &&
test -d "$RUN_FOLDER" &&
test -d "$SCENE_VIDEO_FOLDER" &&
test -d "$TTS_FOLDER" &&
echo "RUN_FOLDERS_READY" &&
echo "$RUN_FOLDER"
`
}}
